notes.title: The Kurukshetra War update coming up.
notes.content:
.With this update you will find all sorts of improvements and new content!
•    New playable characters
•    A new set of core quests
•    The conclusion to the epic story of the Pandavas
•    New enemies to face
Check out the update coming up!

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
Hi guys,

We pushed an patch to the game. 
We have fixed: 
Progression issues, 
Polished art work,
Bug Fixes.

We appreciate the support and hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello All,

We have pushed an update to the game. We have fixed the world map game crashing bug. Extended the tutorial and are working on the game play update next.

tags.bug: We have fixed the world map game crashing bug.

notes.title: Update 2 is here
notes.content:
We have just pushed an update to TOMB. 

We have extended the tutorial and opened up access to more quests.

We appreciate the support and feedback the community have been giving us and looking forward to continue the same. 

We shall post more updates soon. 

Stay tuned !

Thank you everyone.
